summary: Verified floating image functionality in RTF Editor. All new features working correctly: image popover with 'Em linha' and 'Flutuante' options, floating images with position:absolute via CSS class, selection with cyan border, drag-to-move functionality, and position persistence.
passed_tests: ✅ Image insertion popover shows two options: 'Em linha' and 'Flutuante'
✅ Popover includes description text explaining each option
✅ Floating image is inserted with class 'floating-image'
✅ Floating image has position:absolute via CSS class (.floating-image)
✅ Floating image has initial position: left:20px, top:20px
✅ Clicking on floating image selects it (adds 'selected-image' class)
✅ Selected floating image shows cyan border (outline: 3px solid #22d3ee)
✅ Dragging floating image moves it to new position
✅ Image position changed from left:20px/top:20px to left:100px/top:60px after drag
✅ Image position persists after drag (stored in style attribute)
✅ Inline image option still works normally (no floating-image class)
✅ Inline images follow text flow with margin: 8px 0

features_verified: Description: 'Em linha: segue o fluxo do texto'
Description: 'Flutuante: posição livre, arraste para mover'
CSS position: absolute via class (not inline)
Click on floating image adds 'selected-image' class
Mouse move updates left/top style properties
Position values stored in inline style
Tested: moved from left:20px/top:20px to left:100px/top:60px
Em linha button inserts inline image
